body.name: Abyssal Trident
body.description: Embodying the unfulfilled desires of the Fallen King of the Sea, the sharp tip of this spear constantly drips with the frigid waters of the deep abyss.
body.effect:
Deals an additional 10 ice magical damage and inflicts wet for 3 seconds on hit.

Wet: The target loses -20% move speed bonus and jump height is reduced by 0%.

body.name: Spear of Rot
body.description: Spear imbued with the rotting essence of the fallen, carrying the stench of decay.

body.name: Spectral Blade
body.description: A newly forged blade crafted upon the hilt of a loyal guardian’s sword. A cold aura shimmers along the center of the blade, and it is said that those who wield it for long begin to hear faint, unknown whispers.

body.name: Spectral Cloak
body.description: A cloak woven from the hem of a Spectral Knight’s garment and fabric imbued with magic. The torn parts return to their original state no matter how many times they are patched, making repairs impossible. Though it appears worn, a cold magical energy flows along the cloak’s weave.

body.name: Spectral Coinbag
body.description: This isn't your typical bag. The inclusion of spectral fabric, a rare material that straddles both realms, gives it a capacity that defies mortal understanding.

body.name: Spectral Fabric
body.description: This fabric shimmers with an ethereal sheen, holding the chill of the netherworld within its threads.

body.name: Spectral Hilt
body.description: Once wielded by a guardian whose allegiance transcended mortality, this hilt resonates with echoes of undying loyalty. Its cold touch is a solemn reminder of a pact sealed beyond the veil of death.

body.name: Spellbook
body.description: Crafted from engraved leather bindings and pages etched with magical ancient runes and markings.

body.name: Spellweaver
body.description: A rare spellbook pulsing with arcane energy, whispering ancient secrets in an unknown language. Rumored to have been taken from a mysterious land only accessible through special portals.
body.effect: Successfully casting a spell increases your casting speed by 5%, up to 5 times. The effect lasts for 5 seconds and is reset each time it increases.

body.name: Spellplunder Rod
body.description: The final project of a sorcerer who vanished under mysterious circumstances. Imbued with forbidden magic, it not only steals spells but also echoes with the anguish of those whose magic it has seized, a grim companion thirsting for arcane power.
body.effect: Restore 24 spell memory per hit when attacking.

body.name: Spent Candle
body.description: A candle with a short wick and hardened wax clinging to its sides. It still looks usable, but barely.

body.name: Spider Silk
body.description: A delicate yet robust fiber.

body.name: Spiked Gauntlet
body.description: A heavy metal gauntlet lined with sharp spikes, intimidating enough to make onlookers flinch. The spikes running from the back of the hand to the forearm are not mere decoration, but meant to deal real damage in combat. As much a weapon as it is armor, this gauntlet must be worn with care. A single misstep can injure the wearer just as easily as the enemy.

body.name: Splendid Cloak
body.description: A splendid cloak tinged with red that seemed to move at any moment.
